name: Geten no Hana Yume Akari
source:
Nobunaga survives Honnōji and resumes his conquests abroad. Hideyoshi completes his mission to pacify the Chugoku region and returns to Azuchi Castle for a break. The story continues one month after the first game. The protagonist serves as Nobunaga's kunoichi and continues to protect Azuchi Castle from enemy spies as the "Shield of Azuchi".

[from [url=http://koei.wikia.com/wiki/Geten_no_Hana_Yumeakari]Koei Wikia[/url]]
translation:
信长在本能寺之变中幸存下来，继续在海外征服领土。秀吉完成平定中国地方的任务后，回到安土城休息。故事承接第一部作品，一个月后继续展开。主角作为信长的女忍者，以“安土之盾”的身份继续保护安土城免受敌方间谍侵扰。

[来自 [url=http://koei.wikia.com/wiki/Geten_no_Hana_Yumeakari]Koei Wikia[/url]]
